title: Evaluation of a polynomial in an extension field, and roots
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, $T$ an indeterminate and $K[T]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Let $L$ be a field together with a ring homomorphism $\iota:K\to L$ (for instance a subfield inclusion $K\subseteq L$, or $K=\Ql$ and $L=\Qlb$ an algebraic closure). For $P(T)=\sum_{n\geq0}c_nT^n\in K[T]$ and $x\in L$, the value of $P$ at $x$ is

$$
P(x)=\sum_{n\geq0}\iota(c_n)\,x^n\in L,
$$

the image of $P$ under the unique ring homomorphism $K[T]\to L$ that restricts to $\iota$ on $K$ and sends $T$ to $x$. A *root* of $P$ in $L$ is an element $x\in L$ with $P(x)=0$. When $L=K$ and $\iota=\mathrm{id}$ this is the usual evaluation $P(x)\in K$; in particular $P(0)=c_0$ is the constant coefficient.

source.place: node def-weil-ordinary-reciprocal-roots, order 2859: 'An *ordinary root* is a scalar $\beta\in\Qlb$ satisfying $P(\beta)=0$' for $P(T)\in\Ql[T]$, and 'All roots are taken in this chosen algebraically closed field $\Qlb$'; the evaluation of a polynomial over $\Ql$ at a point of $\Qlb$ is used there without definition

mathlib_searches.query: evaluate polynomial at element along ring homomorphism, root of polynomial
evaluation of a polynomial at an element via a ring homomorphism, sum of f(c_n) x^n

mathlib_searches.results: eval₂ (f : R →+* S) (x : S) (p : R[X]) := p.sum fun e a => f a * x ^ e (57); IsRoot p a := p.eval a = 0 (355); eval₂_eq_eval_map (565)

mathlib_match.how: exact: `Polynomial.eval₂ ι x P` is $P(x)$ for `P : K[X]`, `ι : K →+* L`, `x : L` (equivalently `(P.map ι).eval x` by `Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map`, or `Polynomial.aeval x P` when `L` is a `K`-algebra); a root of $P$ in $L$ is `Polynomial.IsRoot (P.map ι) x` (Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Eval/Defs.lean:355) Re-check 2026-10-09: types read; `eval₂ ι x P` is by definition Σ ι(c_n) x^n, the node's P(x) for ι : K →+* L; root = `(P.map ι).IsRoot x` ↔ `eval₂ ι x P = 0` by `eval₂_eq_eval_map`.
